title: Design System: i-clinic -- The Case Sheet

display.purpose: h1/h2/h3, sign-in heading -- not a separate typeface, same Inter family as body.

mono.purpose: Token numbers, elapsed minutes, rupee amounts. Never label text (see The Mono-Is-For-Numerals Rule).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus/border transitions and the token-queue row insert/remove animation (motion/react).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default task action (Check in, Confirm payment). No shadow, instant color-only state changes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(50% 0.155 40); color: oklch(99% 0 0); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(44% 0.16 40); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: oklch(38% 0.16 40); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(50% 0.155 40 / 38%); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Ruled rectangular search field with an inline currentColor SVG icon, not a pill.
components.css: .ds-search-field { position: relative; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 1rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: oklch(46% 0.032 50); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-strip { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; height: 3.25rem; font-size: 1.0625rem; padding: 0 1.5rem 0 2.75rem; color: oklch(25% 0.03 45); background: oklch(94% 0.035 78); border: 1px solid oklch(68% 0.065 62); border-radius: 4px; outline: none; } .ds-search-strip::placeholder { color: oklch(46% 0.032 50); } .ds-search-strip:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(50% 0.155 40); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(50% 0.155 40 / 38%); }

components.name: Tab-Flag Heading
components.description: The signature section-label device: an angled-corner chip evoking a folder index tab. Used above every record section (Queue, Comments, Demographics, Procedures, Pricing).
components.css: .ds-readout-heading { display: inline-block; margin: 0 0 0.75rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; background: oklch(85.5% 0.05 72); color: oklch(42% 0.04 48); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 7px) 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }

components.name: Stage Pill
components.description: Neutral bordered chip carrying a per-stage SVG glyph shape (the colour-blind-safe signal) plus the stage label word; color never carries the signal alone.
components.html: Paid
components.css: .ds-stage-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(58% 0.07 58); border-radius: 3px; background: oklch(94% 0.035 78); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(42% 0.04 48); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Token Chit
components.description: Dashed-border ticket-stub chit displaying the queue token number in mono numerals.
components.css: .ds-readout-token { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 3px; border: 1.5px dashed oklch(50% 0.155 40); background: oklch(50% 0.155 40 / 12%); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(50% 0.155 40); }

components.name: Record Panel
components.description: The one bordered panel per pane (case-sheet, queue readout, form panel). Sections inside divide by border-top hairlines only, never a nested card.
components.html:
Section one content
Section two content
components.css: .ds-record-area { background: oklch(94% 0.035 78); border: 1px solid oklch(68% 0.065 62); border-radius: 6px; padding: 1.5rem 2.5rem 2.5rem; } .ds-record-section { margin-top: 2.5rem; padding-top: 1.5rem; } .ds-record-section.ds-ruled { border-top: 1px solid oklch(68% 0.065 62); }

components.name: Paid Stamp
components.description: The app's one signature/delight component: a rotated bordered PAID mark shown only on an actually confirmed payment, with uneven corners and an offset ghost shadow reading as an imperfect rubber-stamp impression. CSS-only, not a rendered/distressed asset.
components.css: .ds-paid-stamp { display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; padding: 0.25rem 1rem; border: 3px solid oklch(40% 0.09 152); border-radius: 5px 3px 6px 2px; box-shadow: 1.5px 1px 0 0 oklch(40% 0.09 152 / 12%); color: oklch(40% 0.09 152); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; transform: rotate(-6deg); }

narrative.overview: This is v4 of the app's visual world, replacing v3 ("Cobalt," a tech-blue SaaS theme). The thesis: an Operate-mode two-person clinic tool should look like what the doctor and receptionist already use on paper -- a case sheet, a token chit, a rubber ink stamp -- not a generic dashboard. The build commits to a warm kraft/manila paper ground (never a sterile white or a tinted-cool near-white), warm charcoal-brown ink (never cool grey), one terracotta accent reserved for the accentable moment, and a forest-green ink-stamp reserved for confirmed/paid. Depth comes from a hairline rule, never a shadow -- paper doesn't float. This app has exactly one page family: app pages (Reception, Consultation, Billing, sign-in) for two roles who scan and act under time pressure, often with a patient in the room. No marketing surface exists anywhere in this codebase -- no hero, no testimonial, no pricing table, no footer -- and none should be introduced. Confirmed rejections: no card-stack-of-identical-bordered-cards for Consultation's record (the world this replaces); no second display typeface (Space Grotesk was removed -- one workhorse family, Inter, carries headings, body, and UI); no invented clinic brand name or logo.
keyCharacteristics: Warm kraft/manila ground and charcoal-brown ink, never a cool near-white or grey
One terracotta accent, held rare; forest-green reserved for confirmed/paid
Hairline rules and tab-flag section labels instead of nested cards
Sharp, cut-paper corners (small radii) instead of soft rounding
Mono reserved strictly for numerals, never for label text

rules.name: The Colour-Is-Reinforcement Rule
rules.body: Every stage in the token queue carries a distinct SVG glyph shape in addition to its color, and the label word is always shown alongside. Color alone never carries the signal.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: The forest-green ink-stamp treatment appears only on an actually confirmed payment, never reused decoratively elsewhere.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-For-Numerals Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved strictly for genuinely numeric content, never for label text, even within a class that is mono elsewhere for its numeric use.

rules.name: The One Bordered Panel Rule
rules.body: Each pane gets exactly one bordered container. Sections within it are ruled (border-top), never individually carded.

dos: Do use the kraft/manila ground tokens (--bg/--surface/--surface-2) as-is; they were deliberately corrected for chroma/lightness in finish review and should not be lightened back toward a cool near-white.
Do apply .readout-heading's tab-flag clip-path to every new record-section label; it is the system's one recurring signature motif, not a one-off.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for genuine numerals (tokens, minutes, rupees) and keep label text, including text that shares a class with numeric content, on the Inter body face.
Do keep every Consultation record section visible and scrollable at once inside its one bordered panel; PRODUCT.md's one-screen requirement is durable, not a task-local choice.
donts: Don't stack multiple individually-bordered cards inside a pane. One bordered panel per pane; sections inside it divide by border-top hairlines only.
Don't add a box-shadow as a general elevation device. The one exception (.paid-stamp's ghost-offset shadow) is welded to that component as a rubber-stamp effect, not a reusable shadow token.
Don't introduce a second display typeface. One family (Inter) carries headings, body, and UI; Space Grotesk was removed in this build and should not return.
Don't invent a clinic brand name, logo, or fixed identity anywhere in this app. It renders whichever clinic's own name is stored in its database row.
Don't let --stage-pill's container color vary by stage. Color reinforces; the SVG shape and label word are the actual colour-blind-safe signal.
